body: Vinit Teredesai (CFO) on 2025-10-14 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "if we are looking at our current trajectory, we are looking at 100 basis point improvement in FY26, and probably another 100 basis point in FY27" Metric: EBIT margin (company). Target: +100 bp vs FY25 14.7%. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-22: delivered. Evidence: FY26 EBIT margin 15.6% (+90 bp; company, Q4FY26 call), despite a one-time 230 bp labour-code charge in Q3. Within 0.3 pp of +100 bp. Screener-derived (OP-dep)/sales FY26 16.2% (different classification).
